content: Standard pattern for npx-launched local browser UIs (MCP Inspector, Prisma Studio, Codex WebApp precedents): bind HTTP server to 127.0.0.1 only, never 0.0.0.0; require a per-session random token embedded in the auto-opened URL to prevent other web pages/tabs from hitting the local API (DNS-rebinding/CSRF-style protection); print explicit warning if user overrides to non-loopback host.
